caption: The drawing shows a rectangular piece of fabric or parchment with a scene arranged horizontally. In the center sits a female figure wearing a long red dress with gold trim at the collar and hem, and she has light-colored hair tied back, with her hands resting in her lap and to her side. Surrounding the figure are large green leaves with blue shading and prominent yellow veins, as well as swirling vines and red berries. Clusters of brown circular shapes, resembling grapes, are distributed around the drawing. On the right side of the composition, there is a blue and gray bird perched among the stems and leaves, near smaller red fruit and a pinkish-orange flower with multiple petals. Other small blue and yellow flowers with fine stems decorate the edges. The background of the piece is a light, beige color, showing a woven or linen-like texture. Red and green vines arc and curl throughout the design, integrating the plants and figures. The drawing primarily features shades of red, green, blue, gold, brown, and beige.
title: Crewel Embroidered Valance
